notes.title: My new game: Midnight Sin
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]I'm really excited to announce my third game "Midnight Sin" to all of you![/p][p]After another 3 years of development, it's almost ready for release.[/p][p]You can check out the trailer and store page [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3877070/Midnight_Sin/"]here![/url][/p][p]It would [b]really[/b] help me if you would add the game to your wishlist![/p][p][/p][p]I expect the game to be ready for release early 2026.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for the amazing support for both Man of the House and Mystwood Manor![/p][p]I hope you will enjoy Midnight Sin just as much.[/p][p][/p][p]All the best,[/p][p]Faerin[/p]

notes.title: My new game: Mystwood Manor!
notes.notes:
Hey everone,

I'm really excited to finally announce my upcoming, new game "Mystwood Manor" to all of you!
After close to 3 years of development, it's almost ready for release.

The trailer and store page are already finished, so go and have a look: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1863670/Mystwood_Manor/]here![/url]
It would [b]really[/b] help me if you would add the game to your wishlist (if you're interested, of course).

I will post more updates in the coming weeks and expect/hope the game to be ready for release in September.

Thank you all for the amazing support for Man of the House!
I hope you will enjoy Mystwood Manor just as much.

All the best,
Faerin

notes.title: Will MotH win the game of the year award?
notes.notes:
Hey fellow pervs :)

The Steam Award nominations are underway and it would be awesome if you would nominate MotH for game of the year! 

Of course, I know, it's never going to happen, but it would be cool if we can cause some more attention for the adult game category (since there is no award category for that yet) and put MotH in the spotlight a bit.

You can cast your vote on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1148150]shop page[/url]!

Thanks a lot for your support!

notes.title: Trading cards are now live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

I have added trading cards to Man of the House.
There's a total of 10 different ones that you can try to collect to complete the set and exchange them for cool rewards!

Have fun!

All the best,
Faerin
